#读入数据部分调整
```{r}
after <- merge(AML1002.4,y=c(AML1008.3,AML1010.3,AML1012.3,AML1016.2,AML1022.3,AML1026.3))
at <- scRNA1[,scRNA1$orig.ident %in%c('AML1002.4',"AML1008.3","AML1010.3","AML1012.3","AML1016.2","AML1022.3","AML1026.3")]
table(after$orig.ident)
table(at$orig.ident)

after$barcode <- colnames(after)
head(after$barcode)
at$barcode <- colnames(at)
head(at$barcode)
at$barcode <- sub("_.*", "", at$barcode)
at$bar <- paste(at$orig.ident,"GEX", sep = ".")
at$barcode <- paste(at$bar, at$barcode, sep = "_")


common_columns <- which(after$barcode %in% at$barcode)
after@meta.data$ture <- 'N' 
after@meta.data$ture[common_columns] <- 'T'
table(after$ture)
after <- after[,after$ture %in% c('T')]

# 获取 at 和 after 的 barcode 列
barcodes_at <- at@meta.data$barcode
barcodes_after <- after@meta.data$barcode

# 创建一个新的列 'true'，初始值为 'N'
after@meta.data$true <- 'N'

# 找到 at 中的 barcode 是否存在于 after 中
after@meta.data$true[after@meta.data$barcode %in% barcodes_at] <- 'T'

# 查看更新后的 after@meta.data
head(after@meta.data)
after$ture <- NULL
after <- after[,after$true %in% c('T')]

#将一列列进行映射
# 获取 at 和 after 的 barcode 列
barcodes_at <- at@meta.data$barcode
barcodes_after <- after@meta.data$barcode

# 获取 at 中的 Celltype 列
celltype_at <- at@meta.data$Celltype

# 在 after 中创建一个新的列 'Celltype'
after@meta.data$Celltype <- NA

# 将 at 中的 Celltype 映射到 after 中
after@meta.data$Celltype[after@meta.data$barcode %in% barcodes_at] <- celltype_at[match(after@meta.data$barcode[after@meta.data$barcode %in% barcodes_at], barcodes_at)]
# 加载 dplyr 包
library(dplyr)

# 定义新的 Celltype 名称
new_celltypes <- c("HSC/MPP", "GMP", "MEP", "EBM", "Early Ery", 
                   "Mid Ery", "Later Ery", "Monocyte", "cDC", 
                   "pDC", "B", "T", "NK")

# 修改 Celltype 列
after@meta.data$Celltype <- as.character(after@meta.data$Celltype) # 确保是字符型
after@meta.data$Celltype <- recode(after@meta.data$Celltype, 
                                   `1` = new_celltypes[1], 
                                   `2` = new_celltypes[2], 
                                   `3` = new_celltypes[3], 
                                   `4` = new_celltypes[4], 
                                   `5` = new_celltypes[5], 
                                   `6` = new_celltypes[6], 
                                   `7` = new_celltypes[7], 
                                   `8` = new_celltypes[8], 
                                   `9` = new_celltypes[9], 
                                   `10` = new_celltypes[10], 
                                   `11` = new_celltypes[11], 
                                   `12` = new_celltypes[12], 
                                   `13` = new_celltypes[13])

# 查看更新后的 Celltype
table(after@meta.data$Celltype)

```
##降维聚类
```{r}
scRNA <- scRNA1[,!scRNA1$orig.ident %in% c('AML1002.4',"AML1008.3","AML1010.3","AML1012.3","AML1016.2","AML1022.3","AML1026.3")]
scRNA <- merge(scRNA,after)
scRNA <- NormalizeData(scRNA) %>% FindVariableFeatures(nfeatures = 2000) %>% ScaleData()
scRNA <- RunPCA(scRNA, verbose = F)
scRNA <- RunHarmony(scRNA,group.by.vars = "orig.ident")
scRNA <- scRNA %>% RunUMAP(dims=1:20,reduction = "harmony")
scRNA <- FindNeighbors(scRNA, dims=1:20,reduction = "harmony")
```

```{r}

  pivot_wider(id_cols = 'source', names_from = 'condition',
              values_from = 'score') %>%
  column_to_rownames('source') %>%
  Seurat::CreateAssayObject(.)

# Change assay
```

```{r}
#OR
# 提供数据治疗前后
cr_counts <-  c(652, 336, 322, 53, 49, 117, 187, 161, 211, 144, 51, 110, 163, 1, 47, 59, 37, 72, 36)#CR治疗前
ctrl_counts <-  c(797, 490, 530, 125, 67, 191, 276, 358, 533, 271, 100, 283, 345, 1, 211, 81, 77, 107, 82)#CR治疗后

cr_counts <-  c(109, 111, 86, 34, 17, 0, 79, 37, 96, 52, 33, 104, 92, 4, 8, 28, 15, 28, 30)#NR治疗前
ctrl_counts <-  c(244, 256, 276, 72, 37, 0, 82, 85, 100, 44, 31, 93, 181, 1, 6, 74, 18, 42, 23)#NR治疗后

cell_types <- c("CD4_Na_TCF7","CD4_Tscm_FAS","CD4_Tcm_FOS","Treg",
                "CD8_Na_LEF1",  "CD8_Tcm_CD28",
                "CD8_Tem_GIMAP4","CD8_Tem_IFNG", 
                "CD8_Ttm_GNLY", "CD8_Ttm_IKZF2", "CD8_Ttm_THEMIS",
                "CD8_Te_ASCL2", "CD8_Te_IFNG", "CD8_Te_IFIT1","CD8_Te_S100B",
                "CD3_Ex_LAG3", "MAIT", "NKT","γδT")
# 创建一个函数来计算OR值、log2OR值和Fisher's精确检验的p值
calculate_OR_and_pvalue <- function(cr_count, ctrl_count) {
  # 计算OR值
  odds_ratio <- (cr_count[1] / cr_count[2]) / (ctrl_count[1] / ctrl_count[2])
  # 计算Fisher's精确检验的p值
  fisher_test <- fisher.test(matrix(c(cr_count, ctrl_count), nrow = 2))
  p_value <- fisher_test$p.value
  # 计算log2OR值
  log2_odds_ratio <- log2(odds_ratio)
  # 返回OR值、log2OR值和Fisher's精确检验的p值
  return(list(OR = odds_ratio, log2_OR = log2_odds_ratio, p_value = p_value))
}

# 创建一个空列表来存储OR值、log2OR值和Fisher's精确检验的p值
result_list <- list()

# 循环遍历每种细胞类型，并计算OR值、log2OR值和Fisher's精确检验的p值
for (i in seq_along(cell_types)) {
  cr_count <- c(cr_counts[i], sum(cr_counts))
  ctrl_count <- c(ctrl_counts[i], sum(ctrl_counts))
  result_list[[i]] <- calculate_OR_and_pvalue(cr_count, ctrl_count)
}

# 将结果组合成数据框
result_df <- data.frame(Cell_Type = cell_types, OR_Value = sapply(result_list, function(x) x$OR), 
                        log2_OR_Value = sapply(result_list, function(x) x$log2_OR),
                        p_value = sapply(result_list, function(x) x$p_value))

# 输出结果
print(result_df)
###CR治疗前后 '#EC88BA','#F2A6C1'
result_df$color <- ifelse(result_df$log2_OR_Value > 0, '#9684C2','#AFA0D4')
result_df$significance <- ifelse(result_df$p_value < 0.001, "***", ifelse(result_df$p_value < 0.01, "**", ifelse(result_df$p_value < 0.05, "*", "n.s")))

result_df$Cell_Type <- factor(result_df$Cell_Type, levels = c("CD4_Na_TCF7","CD4_Tscm_FAS","CD4_Tcm_FOS","Treg",
                                                              "CD8_Na_LEF1",  "CD8_Tcm_CD28",
                                                              "CD8_Tem_GIMAP4","CD8_Tem_IFNG", 
                                                              "CD8_Ttm_GNLY", "CD8_Ttm_IKZF2", "CD8_Ttm_THEMIS",
                                                              "CD8_Te_ASCL2", "CD8_Te_IFNG", "CD8_Te_IFIT1","CD8_Te_S100B",
                                                              "CD3_Ex_LAG3", "MAIT", "NKT","γδT"), ordered = TRUE)
# Plot
ggplot(result_df, aes(x = Cell_Type, y = log2_OR_Value, fill = color)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  geom_text(aes(label = significance, 
                y = ifelse(log2_OR_Value >= 0, log2_OR_Value-0.05, log2_OR_Value)), 
            vjust = ifelse(result_df$log2_OR_Value >= 0, -0.75, 1.5), size = 4) +  # 调整标签位置
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1,vjust = 0.5),
        axis.text = element_text(size = 10),  # 调整两个坐标轴的文本大小
        axis.ticks = element_line(size = 0.5),  # 调整坐标轴刻度的粗细
        panel.grid.major = element_blank(),  # 移除主要网格线
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),  # 移除次要网格线
        axis.line = element_line(color = "black", size = 0.5),  # 线条细化
        panel.border = element_blank(),  # 移除面板边框
        panel.background = element_blank(),
        plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5)) +  # 移除面板背景
  labs(x = "", y = "Enrichment
(log2OR)", title = "NR patient before and after treatment") +  # 更改坐标轴和标题的标签为中文
  scale_fill_identity()
```

```{r}
#热图每个组之间差异及表达量
expression_data <- FetchData(T4, 
                             vars = c("IKZF2", "Celltype", "condition3"))
# 2. 计算平均表达量
avg_expression <- aggregate(IKZF2 ~ Celltype + condition3, 
                            data = expression_data, 
                            FUN = mean)

# 3. 计算统计差异
# 假设第二组作为对照组，需要你自己去看
control_group <- unique(expression_data$condition3)[3]

# 创建一个空的数据框来存储统计结果
stats_results <- data.frame()
expression_data <- expression_data[complete.cases(expression_data), ]
for(cell in unique(expression_data$Celltype)) {
  for(cond in unique(expression_data$condition3)) {
    if(cond != control_group) {
      # 提取当前组和对照组的数据
      current_data <- subset(expression_data, Celltype == cell & condition3 == cond)$IKZF2
      control_data <- subset(expression_data, Celltype == cell & condition3 == control_group)$IKZF2
      
      test_result <- wilcox.test(current_data, control_data)
      
      # 添加结果到数据框
      stats_results <- rbind(stats_results,
                             data.frame(Celltype = cell,
                                        condition3 = cond,
                                        p.value = test_result$p.value))
    }
  }
}

# 添加显著性标记
stats_results$stars <- ifelse(stats_results$p.value < 0.001, "***",
                              ifelse(stats_results$p.value < 0.01, "**",
                                     ifelse(stats_results$p.value < 0.05, "*", "")))

# 4. 转换为矩阵格式
expression_matrix <- reshape2::dcast(avg_expression, 
                                     Celltype ~ condition3, 
                                     value.var = "IKZF2")

# 5. 转换为矩阵
matrix_data <- as.matrix(expression_matrix[,-1])
rownames(matrix_data) <- expression_matrix$Celltype

# 6. 合并平均值和显著性标记
avg_expression <- merge(avg_expression, stats_results, 
                        by = c("Celltype", "condition3"), 
                        all.x = TRUE)
head(avg_expression)
# 7. 绘制热图
ggplot(avg_expression, aes(x = condition3, y = Celltype, fill = IKZF2)) +
  geom_tile() +
  scale_fill_gradient2(low = "navy", 
                       mid = "white", 
                       high = "red", 
                       midpoint = mean(avg_expression$IKZF2)) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(panel.grid.major = element_blank(),  # 去掉主要网格线
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),  # 去掉次要网格线
    legend.position = "right",
    legend.box.just = "center",
    legend.justification = "center",
    legend.key.height = unit(1, "cm"),
    legend.key.width = unit(0.5, "cm"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, 
                               hjust = 1, 
                               size = 10),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 12),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 10)) +
  labs(fill = "Expression",
       x = "",
       y = "Cell Type") +
  # 添加显著性标记，不显示具体数值
  geom_text(aes(label = ifelse(!is.na(stars),paste0(round(IKZF2, 2), stars),round(IKZF2, 2))), size = 3, na.rm = TRUE) +
  ggtitle("IKZF2") +  # 添加标题
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5,vjust = 0.5))
```
